_meta.as_of: today's reference date for the deadline commentary is 2026-07-10
_meta.method: Each case was hand-computed FIRST against that year's confirmed constants in constants-multiyear.json (see workings), then confirmed reproducible by scripts/validate.py --selftest. The harness recomputes scenario_original and scenario_corrected for the case's income_year and checks: coleta_liquida of each scenario, and recoverable = cl_original - cl_corrected, against the hand-derived expected values. Expected values are NEVER edited to match code; on a mismatch the workings are re-derived by hand.
_meta.recoverable_definition: recoverable_eur = coleta_liquida_original - coleta_liquida_corrected = the extra IRS refund (or reduced amount owed) that recomputing the past return with the missed item would have produced, assuming retenções/pagamentos are unchanged.

flags.recoverable: Arithmetic recovery > 0 AND a live correction instrument still exists.
flags.recoverable_below_materiality: Recovery > 0 but small enough that the filing effort/opportunity cost may exceed the benefit; stated so the user decides.
flags.no_recovery_cap_bound: Recomputation shows recovery = 0 (the 'missed' deduction is fully displaced, e.g. the global cap was already binding). Negative control.
flags.unrecoverable_time_barred: Arithmetic recovery > 0 but every viable instrument's legal deadline has lapsed (or the only long-window instrument, revisão oficiosa, does not cover a pure voluntary omission). Money is real but legally unreachable.

_meta.correction_paths_ref: Full instrument definitions, deadlines and citations live in constants-multiyear.json _meta.correction_paths and in SKILL.md 'Retro-audit and correction paths'.
_meta.law_version: income years 2022-2024, each on its own Artigo 68.º table; global-cap upper endpoint = Artigo 68.º-A n.º 1 floor (80 000) for all years
_meta.derivation_caveat: SINGLE-PATH. scripts/oracle.py models income year 2025 only, so these expected values are produced by scripts/estimator.py alone and carry none of the dual-path evidence the 2025 golden corpus carries. Treat a green retro run as a regression check, NOT as confirmation the figures are right. Extending the oracle to 2022-2024 is the highest-value open item on this corpus.

cases.label: Forgot a 2000 EUR PPR contribution on a 2024 return (single, cat A 30k)
cases.correction_path: Declaracao de substituicao a favor do contribuinte / reclamacao graciosa; if the 120-day window has lapsed, revisao oficiosa (LGT art. 78, 4 anos) via an OCC (a forgotten PPR is a taxpayer omission, so confirm the ground).
cases.deadline: Income 2024 filed 2025: reclamacao graciosa 120 dias do termo do prazo de pagamento (likely lapsed by 2026-07); revisao oficiosa open until ~2029 (4 anos da liquidacao).

cases.label: Forgot habitacao rent on a 2023 return (single, cat A 20k) - 2023 rent cap was 502
cases.correction_path: Reclamacao graciosa (120 dias) if still open, else revisao oficiosa via OCC; or declaracao de substituicao a favor.
cases.deadline: Income 2023 filed 2024: reclamacao graciosa lapsed; revisao oficiosa open until ~2028 (4 anos da liquidacao de 2024), ground permitting.

cases.label: Unvalidated health invoices on a 2024 return (single, cat A 40k)
cases.workings: 2024: RC=40000-4350.24=35649.76 (bracket 6, 27146-39791 @0.355). coleta=T(27146)+(35649.76-27146)*0.355=5791.22+8503.76*0.355=5791.22+3018.8348=8810.0548 -> 8810.05. Original: cl_original=8810.05. Corrected: health 15%*8000=1200, cap 1000 -> 1000. Global limit at RC 35649.76 = 1000+1500*(80000-35649.76)/72297=1920.17 (non-binding). cl_corrected=8810.05-1000=7810.05. recoverable=1000.00. Reminder: health deductions require e-Fatura VALIDATION by the ~2 March following the income year; unvalidated invoices are exactly what gets missed.
cases.correction_path: Reclamacao graciosa / declaracao de substituicao a favor; revisao oficiosa via OCC if lapsed. If the invoices were never validated in e-Fatura, validation itself may no longer be possible - route to OCC.
cases.deadline: Income 2024 filed 2025: reclamacao graciosa ~120 dias (likely lapsed); revisao oficiosa until ~2029.

cases.label: IRS Jovem year 1 (100%) eligible but not opted in on a 2024 return (single, cat A 25k)
cases.correction_path: IRS Jovem is an OPCAO exercised in the declaration; claiming it after the fact needs a declaracao de substituicao a favor within the reclamacao graciosa window. Option-timing for benefits is contested by AT - route to an OCC before relying on a retro opt-in.
cases.deadline: Income 2024 filed 2025: substitution a favor tied to the ~120-day reclamacao window (likely lapsed); a revisao-oficiosa route for a benefit OPTION is uncertain - OCC-gated.

cases.label: Negative control: missed PPR yields NOTHING because the global cap was already binding (single, cat A 100k)
cases.workings: 2024: RC=100000-4350.24=95649.76 (>80000, bracket 9 @0.48). coleta=T(80000)+(95649.76-80000)*0.48=28326.11+7511.8848=35837.9948 -> 35837.99. RC>80000 -> global cap FLAT 1000. Original: health 15%*8000=1200 -> cap 1000; capped_subject=min(1000,1000)=1000; cl_original=35837.99-1000=34837.99. Corrected: health 1000 + PPR 400 = subject 1400, but flat cap 1000 -> capped_subject=1000 unchanged. cl_corrected=34837.99. recoverable=0.00. The forgotten PPR recovers nothing because the taxpayer was already at the global limit.
cases.correction_path: None warranted - recomputation confirms no money is recoverable. Do NOT file a substitution.

cases.label: Forgot rent on a 2022 return - real 502 EUR arithmetic recovery but legally time-barred (single, cat A 25k)
cases.workings: 2022: spec_A=4104. RC=25000-4104=20896 (bracket 5, 19696-25076 @0.35). coleta=T(19696)+(20896-19696)*0.35=4328.42+1200*0.35=4328.42+420=4748.42. Original: cl_original=4748.42. Corrected: rent 15%*4000=600, 2022 cap 502 -> 502. cl_corrected=4748.42-502=4246.42. recoverable_arithmetic=502.00. BUT: income 2022 was liquidated in 2023; the 120-day reclamacao graciosa window closed in late 2023, the substitution-a-favor window with it, and revisao oficiosa (4 anos, LGT art. 78) requires 'erro imputavel aos servicos' which a pure voluntary omission is not. Practically time-barred by 2026 -> flag unrecoverable.
cases.correction_path: None viable: reclamacao graciosa and substitution-a-favor windows closed; revisao oficiosa ground (erro imputavel aos servicos) does not cover a taxpayer's own forgotten deduction. Route to OCC only to confirm no exceptional ground applies.
cases.deadline: LGT art. 45 caducidade / the lapsed reclamacao window make this unrecoverable as of 2026-07-10.

cases.label: Tiny forgotten health expense on a 2023 return: 6 EUR recoverable, below materiality (single, cat A 10k)
cases.workings: 2023: spec_A=4104. RC=10000-4104=5896 (below 1st ceiling 7479 -> bracket 1 @0.145). coleta=5896*0.145=854.92. Original: cl_original=854.92. Corrected: health 15%*40=6.00. RC 5896 <= 7479 -> global cap UNCAPPED, so the 6.00 applies fully. cl_corrected=854.92-6=848.92. recoverable=6.00. Below a ~25 EUR materiality note: the substitution/reclamacao effort likely exceeds the 6 EUR benefit - state it and let the user decide.
cases.materiality_note: Recovery 6.00 EUR is real but small; flag rather than push a filing.
cases.correction_path: Technically reclamacao graciosa / substituicao a favor (or revisao oficiosa if lapsed), but flag the low materiality first.
cases.deadline: Income 2023 filed 2024: revisao oficiosa window ~until 2028, but not worth it at this magnitude.
